wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 10-003 wires the monster look/chase brain via one src/vanilla facade (wireMonsterLookChase.ts) re-exporting the read-only ai/chase (move/tryWalk/newChaseDir/chase, NUMDIRS 9, OPPOSITE/DIAGS, X_SPEED/Y_SPEED 47000-diagonal tables, FLOATSPEED 4*FRACUNIT), ai/meleeRange (checkMeleeRange, MELEERANGE 64*FRACUNIT, MELEE_RADIUS_ADJUST 20*FRACUNIT, MELEE_BASE_CUTOFF), and ai/missileRange (checkMissileRange + MISSILE_* per-archetype cutoffs). VANILLA_MONSTER_LOOK_CHASE_INVARIANTS pins five rules (9-dir table; FLOATSPEED; melee 64-20 cutoff; per-archetype missile cutoffs; A_Chase active sound). The DirType const enum is intentionally not re-exported (verbatimModuleSyntax); TargetingContext is surfaced from meleeRange only (both range modules re-export it). The focused test exercises the chase tables + range cutoffs, the callable look/chase/range primitives, the frozen manifest, the ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral.
